description: Adapt, preview, and check Douyin mini-game builds.
longDescription: Package games through the engine's Douyin route, check platform configuration, and verify developer-tool and device previews. Requires Douyin's game developer tool and an authorized game account for remote operations. Uploads happen only on request. Adds rewarded video ads that grant only for a finished ad and pause and mute the game around it, and a script that checks the main package against 4 MB right after a build.
example.1: Check this project's Douyin Mini Game integration and local prerequisites.
example.2: Build this game for Douyin and prepare a device preview without uploading a test version.
